The girls are dressed in white and navy school uniforms and sit on red plastic stools. The background consists of a green chalkboard and educational posters. The teacher smiles and gestures towards the camera with a cheerful expression. (2) The camera moves to a medium-close shot of the teacher and one student. The teacher demonstrates a finger dexterity exercise by pressing her palms together and lifting specific fingers on command. The student mimics her actions with intense focus, while the other children in the background watch and laugh. (3) A series of shots show different students participating in the 'Turtle' game. Red arrows appear on the screen to point out which student is being featured. They are all sitting in a row, pressing their palms together and trying to lift the correct fingers. The teacher is visible in the upper frame, guiding them. (4) The final shot returns to a wide view of the group. Everyone is smiling and waving at the camera. The teacher gives a enthusiastic closing talk while the students look happy and energized by the activity. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame throughout the video.
